paper_tables.note: There is no table 3 in the reproduction matrix: the draft's table 3 is not an evaluation table. Tables 2 and 6 share the 32 unguided DiT-XL rows, and tables 1 and 4 share three reconstruction rows, so a selection spanning them is deduplicated.

4.caption: Appendix: random-drop rate sweep for the FuseReg decoder, 8 decoders x 3 readouts.

scope_notes: Main p_dec=.95 reconstruction reuses three appendix_decoder rows; the main table rounds rFID to two decimals.
Main unguided XL grid reuses 32 appendix_xl rows.
The paper default-rate wording says .9 while the main reconstruction table uses .95; each row here selects its explicit reported rate.

The decoder-swap K23 generator is the 80-epoch p_dit=0 DiT-XL and the XL grid uses the 40-epoch export; the two tables report different p_dit=0 baselines for that reason. The decoder-swap K7 generator is the official RAEv2 model and is external to this release.

Decoder-swap guided rows use the official RAEv2 internal-guidance interval t in [0.10, 1.0], which the paper caption names; the evaluator's default interval is [0, 1]. The official sampling config also defaults to 100 steps, while the paper reports 50.
protocol_checks: Verify checkpoint-to-table association, EMA state, architecture and training epoch.
Verify encoder revision and exact layer indices for k7, k23 and l11.
Verify oldnorm/sum/mean scale, latent statistics and fixed final-layer token-mean surrogate behavior.
Verify ImageNet split/preprocessing, FID/IS implementation and reference statistics, sampling seed and internal-guidance implementation.
Keep decoder-swap baseline distinct from the XL grid baseline (3.01/1.25 versus 2.91/1.57 gFID).

The preserved oldnorm sampler repairs an empty mask by retaining one random layer; the manuscript models strict conditional resampling. Preserve the checkpoint recipe and resolve this scientific discrepancy before claiming training equivalence.

The full-target DiT implementation uses logit-normal time sampling and a dimension-based shift; the manuscript writes uniform sampling. Preserve the source recipe and resolve the reporting difference.

identity_verification.scope: Original checkpoint hash matches paper provenance; all exported EMA decoder tensors exactly match. This does not verify paper table metrics or evaluator protocol.

decoder_official_k7.description: Official fixed-fusion RAEv2 K7 decoder; not the reproduced p=0 run

candidates.evidence: Hub LFS SHA-256 metadata; 456-tensor bare decoder state dict read from the pickle header. The paper records no hash for this decoder, so the association rests on it being the only ImageNet DINOv3-L K7 decoder RAEv2 publishes. Download with --local-dir <assets-root>/raev2-models.

decoder_official_k7.output_normalization_evidence: RAEv2 RAE.decode returns decoder.unpatchify(logits) and its reconstruction evaluator clamps that to [0, 1] with no ImageNet de-normalization (nanovisionx/RAEv2 src/stage1/rae.py, src/eval/reconstruction.py).

generator_swap_k7.description: Fixed generator for the decoder-swap K7 columns: the official RAEv2 ImageNet DINOv3-L K7 stage-2 model
generator_swap_k7.evidence: Source author (2026-09-20): the K7 generator is the official RAEv2 checkpoint. It is the only stage-2 model in nyu-visionx/RAEv2-models.

compatibility.architecture: Identical to this release's DiT-XL: DiTwDDTHeadIG, hidden [1440, 2048], depth [28, 2], heads [20, 16], base_model_depth 8 (https://github.com/nanovisionx/RAEv2 configs/stage2/sampling/imagenet-dinov3l-k7.yaml).
compatibility.representation: RAEv2's DINOv3-MLS encoder averages the selected layers and adds the final-layer token mean, matching MLSCombine, despite the README calling it multi-layer-sum.
compatibility.internal_guidance: Supported: the official sampling config sets ig.scale 1.78 over t in [0.10, 1.0].
compatibility.normalization: Trained with per-position [C, H, W] statistics; use latent_stats_k7, not per-channel statistics computed by this repository.

candidates.evidence: Hub LFS SHA-256 metadata; download with --local-dir <assets-root>/raev2-models

latent_stats_k7.description: Official RAEv2 normalization statistics for the DINOv3-L K7 representation the K7 generator was trained on
latent_stats_k7.format: per-position mean and var of shape [C, H, W]; _load_normalization_stats broadcasts it
latent_stats_k7.note: Per-channel statistics from compute_latent_stats.py describe a different normalization and are not a substitute.
